title: Couette-Taylor instabilities in the small gap regime: the very counter-rotating case
summary: In this paper, we study the Couette-Taylor instability of a viscous fluid between two rotating cylinders in the small-gap, slow rescaled rotation rate, high Reynolds number regime, focusing on the very counter-rotating case $μ< μ_c \approx -0.8$ where the primary instability is non-axisymmetric. Starting from the Navier-Stokes equations, we derive a limit system that captures the leading-order dynamics and compute the critical Taylor number $T_c(μ)$ together with the critical axial and azimuthal wavenumbers.
